remarks: HIGhEST and BeST due Sunday 5 pm.Quaint ranch home set off the road on a beautiful, private lot. The home welcomes you with a gracious family room with a large fireplace, built-ins, and beautiful windows that let in lots of natural light. Off the family room is a newly-renovated white kitchen with stainless appliances, light granite countertops, and large eating area. The kitchen has sliding glass doors that open to an expansive deck where you can barbecue and dine al fresco. There's a small mudroom/laundry room that opens to the two-car garage. The quiet area of the home has three nice-sized bedrooms and a full bath. The lower level has a large rec room with fireplace, a separate bedroom with glass doors overlooking the yard, a full bath, and a wet bar. The lower level is in need of renovation and is as-is. The large, level yard has room to play, in addition to a separate fenced-in pool area and pool house. The pool needs a new liner, which is estimated to cost $7000, and is as-is. Convenient to Wilton, New Canaan, and Ridgefield, enjoy the restaurants and shops that all three towns have to offer. This house has tremendous potential.
